name: Ironboot and the six tablets

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The search resumes with Prospector Ironboot, who sends the seeker after the remaining tablets of Mosh'aru. The account now expands beyond the first pair: six tablets form the record under pursuit. Their collection is a quest objective, while the meanings attributed to them must still be read through the words of the characters who interpret them.
